results.rationale: Consistency: paper, coffee cup and wooden tabletop stay in place, with a small change to the paper surface texture. Instruction: a holder appears at the lower-right paper corner, but the original holder remains at upper-left; duplication only partially fulfills moving the existing holder. Quality: both holders, pens, paper and lighting are structurally coherent and natural.

Consistency: gray pavement remains, but the intact deck outline and pose change substantially. Instruction: wheels and trucks are added beneath the board, yet the broken splintered nose remains; the damaged skateboard has not been properly completed. Quality: the ragged layered nose and uneven deck edge are clear structural defects, while wheels and ground shadows remain recognizable.
